thread:
mina: Postmortem up: short summary - simultaneous route-polish job + low DNS TTL (20s) caused a brief out-of-sync forwarding state and a TLS handshake retry surge for cross-region traffic (eu-north-1 -> us-east-1). doc: https://redwood-internal/pms/248500.

raj: noticed the spike in tls_handshake_failures at ~18:04 UTC. SYN_RECV on LBs also spiked.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-084 logged. Alerts suppressed while mitigations applied. :white_check_mark:

net-eng-ana: immediate mitigations: 1) emergency TTL bump to 600s for svc.example (owner: net-eng-ana, done) 2) paused route-polish job (owner: harper, done) 3) rolled back the offending publish (owner: raj, done).

harper: paused polish job at 18:07 UTC. rolling audit on polish config now to find root cause.

mina: triage action items: A) add pre-publish dataplane-consistency check (owner: harper, ETA: 3d) B) raise global minimum TTL for multi-region services to 120s (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 48h) C) add conntrack headroom and autoscale (owner: infra, ETA: 7d) D) TLS handshake canary broken down by source region (owner: mina, ETA: 24h) E) runbook update for emergency TTL bump + rollback steps (owner: raj, ETA: 4d).

raj: opened JIRA NET-472 for dataplane check and NET-473 for TTL floor. will link here when created.

harper: PR for polish-job fix being drafted, will include stricter sequencing and dry-run flag. reviewers: @raj @net-eng-ana.

net-eng-ana: validated TTL change via dig and resolver trace. observed tls_failures dropping to baseline by 18:18 UTC.

sre-bot: Follow-ups created: NET-472, NET-473, INFRA-812, OBS-247.

mina: note to team: adding a checkbox to postmortem template: "recent control-plane batch jobs in last 24h?" will add to doc.

harper: quick debug note: polish job retried a partial publish after a controller race; adding idempotency guard. will post PR link.

mina: thanks everyone. I'll create the reliability board card and assign owners. ping here if you hit blockers. closing thread for now. :sparkles:
